Rarity / amethyst and gold, interlaced corner knots, gem rails
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: A senior grain steward reconciles reports from granaries,
markets, and transport routes into one accountable picture.
Command of the whole system makes this office a powerful
guardian of Egypt's reserves and obligations.
